params.caption: 🎮 Dark Souls 2 and 3 multiplayer is back online FromSoftware says the online servers for Dark Souls 2 and Dark Souls 3 are working again after an outage of nearly two weeks. The fix ends a long quiet spell for players who still play both games online. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 17:24 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer ⚔️ React if you're jumping back in · 💬 DS2 or DS3 tonight? #DarkSouls #FromSoftware #GamingNews
